name: ERP Soft Systems Limited
about: ERP Soft Systems Limited engages in the provision of software support and maintenance services to clients primarily in the United States. The company offers GIS solutions for geospatial data capture, provisioning, mapping, photogrammetric services, and others; building information modeling (BIM) services, such as BIM MEP and structural, building energy modeling, point cloud to BIM, 3D visualization and virtual reality, remodel, documentation, 3D scanning, and scan to BIM services. It also provides ERP solutions, including implementations and consulting, rollouts, application management services, upgrade services and new products, and SAP CRM and SRM; business intelligence, analytics projects, and staffing services; enterprise level salesforce implementation comprising integration, customizations, configurations, reports and dashboards, and app and site development. In addition, the company offers enterprise mobility, BI and reporting, web development, and analytics services. ERP Soft Systems Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Chennai, India.
